periods.time: End of the Tatra base rescue

name.en: Nango Rescues Ouma and Covers the Retreat

periods.summary: Just as massed Abraham clones are about to incinerate Ouma, Torajiro Nango appears, cuts apart the fireball and uses Kotodama to release Ouma from psychokinesis. He tells Ouma that Tsukikage, Kazamatsuri and the three girls are already freed and orders him to take them back to Japan while Nango holds the battlefield. When Arlanz orders clones to pursue, Nango cuts down ten Abrahams with Otogiri and forces PSYON to engage him instead.
periods.cause: Ouma is overwhelmed by PSYON's clone numbers after rescuing the captives, and someone must stop pursuit.
periods.process: Nango slices the combined pyrokinetic attack, commands the clones to release Ouma, and demonstrates his sound-based Kotodama. He insists that the younger fighter rely on the old knight. Arlanz tries to bypass him by using psychokinesis to move clones despite Kotodama, but Nango's Otogiri kills the pursuing clones through sound and makes him impossible to ignore.
periods.outcome: Ouma evacuates the five captives with Charlotte, Sara's camouflage and his wind magic. Nango remains in Europe, beginning a three-day guerrilla delaying action against PSYON.
periods.significance: Allows the political hostages to return to Japan and sets up Nango's later investigation of the Tyrant's stolen Device.
